svg.text: Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 4 of 10: Screen -> Seed3
Read the names printed beside the screen's pins. 'SDO(MISO)' and 'T_IRQ' stay empty. 'GND' is on the ground-chain page.
Steps (the number is on the wire):
screen: pin 1 'VCC' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 3 'CS' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 4 'RESET' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 5 'DC' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 7 'SCK' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 8 'LED' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 10 'T_CLK' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 11 'T_CS' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 12 'T_DIN' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
screen: pin 13 'T_DO' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
